purpose: Multimodal understanding and creation contract; not implementation evidence.
requirements: Distinguish analysis, generation, editing, rendering, and end-to-end production.
Never report success for a pipeline that was not executed.
Record model identity/version, license, source, artifact hash, configuration, logs, resource use, and evaluation results.
Use licensed or otherwise authorized training and evaluation assets.
Respect copyright, image/personality rights, voice consent, DRM and access controls.
Sandbox untrusted media, codecs, plugins, generated code and game projects.
Provide keyboard and screen-reader support, captions/transcripts, alternatives and configurable interaction.
Offer local execution where technically supported; disclose any remote processing.
Measure temporal consistency for video, synchronization for audio/video, and actual playability for games.
Mark simulated, mocked, partial, blocked and unvalidated steps explicitly.

evidence_schema.pass_requires: A reproducible real execution, verifiable output artifact, logs, hashes, acceptance tests and capability-specific quality checks.
